transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because my head just feels... cloudy lately. I manage properties, so I'm used to dealing with a lot of paperwork and decisions, but lately, I just stare at a board packet or an email from a vendor and I can't seem to make a choice. Even simple things that I used to handle fast, I just... I can't decide. It's like my thinking has slowed down.
Alongside this feeling of your thinking slowing down, how has your mood been lately?

Well, my mood... it's been a bit strange. I mean, right now I just feel kind of down with the brain fog. But there were days recently when I felt almost too bright. Bold, I guess. I would be at the association meetings and I'd just talk right over people. And then... well, I'd go home and just snap at my husband over some small little thing. It's just been very up and down.
During those times when you felt so bright and bold, did you find that you needed much less sleep than usual without feeling tired?
No, not really. I mean, I still went to bed around my usual time. I didn't notice feeling like I could just skip sleep or anything like that... I just slept my normal amount, really.
When you have those times of feeling unusually bright, bold, or irritable, how many days in a row do they usually last?

I... I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't ever counted them. It just sort of happens for a bit, and then... well, then it passes and I go back to feeling foggy. I just haven't kept track of exactly how many days in a row it lasts.
For how long have you noticed this pattern of shifting back and forth between feeling up and feeling down?

I'd say it's been about two weeks. This sharper change in my energy and my confidence, and then getting that low, cloudy feeling... it's been going on for two weeks now. It started right around the time my husband retired and was suddenly just home all day.

Well, the depressed stretches... those have actually been coming back on and off for about a year now. It's just that this latest one feels a lot more tied to what happened right after my husband stopped working.
Outside of those low periods over the past year, have you ever had times in your life when you felt unusually energized, euphoric, or hyperactive for several days in a row?

No, I don't think so. I mean, not that I can remember. Before these last couple of weeks, I haven't really had any times where I felt super energized or... what did you say, euphoric? It's just been those low, foggy spells over the past year. Nothing like this sudden burst of energy.
When you had those low, depressed stretches over the past year, how long did each of them typically last?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. I didn't write it down or keep track of the days. Um... they would just kind of settle in for a while, and I'd just push through work until they eventually lifted. I couldn't give you an exact amount of time, really. They just sort of came and went.
During those low spells over the past year, did you lose interest or pleasure in doing things you normally enjoyed?

Yes, I did. Um, I just haven't wanted to go to my dance class, or look at the little galleries like I usually do. I didn't even want to cook Sunday food for my family during those times. And... well, those are the things that usually make me feel like myself. I just didn't have the desire for any of it.

I'm not really sure. Um... I guess between those times, I just went back to my regular routine managing the properties. But I don't really know if I felt completely normal again, or if I just wasn't quite as down. I didn't really pay that much attention to it.
During those low times over the past year, did you notice a significant drop in your energy or feel constantly exhausted?

No, I don't think so. Um... I didn't really feel constantly exhausted or anything like that. I still got up and did my work managing the properties every day. I wouldn't say my energy dropped a whole lot... I just felt down and didn't want to do the extra things, like I mentioned. But physically, I wasn't really any more tired than usual.

No, my sleep was pretty normal, actually. I didn't have any trouble falling asleep at night, and I wasn't sleeping the day away either. I just stuck to my regular schedule.
During those low spells over the past year, did you notice any changes in your appetite or weight?

Well, my eating has been a bit off. I guess during the day, just coffee and a few bites of something is enough to carry me through. And then at night... I just sort of pick at things, like tortillas or some sweets, but I don't really enjoy it. I haven't really noticed my weight changing much, just my appetite.
During those low times over the past year, did you find yourself struggling with feelings of worthlessness or feeling guilty about things?

Yes, I suppose I do feel guilty sometimes. I just... I keep thinking I let the residents down. I have a habit of speaking too big and promising them things before I actually check the money. Even though nobody has actually come out and said I ruined anything, I still feel bad about it during those times.
During those low spells over the past year, did you ever have thoughts that life wasn't worth living, or think about harming yourself?

Well, I definitely don't want to hurt myself, and I don't have any kind of plan to do that. But... I guess a few mornings, I have had this scary thought that maybe it would just be easier if I didn't wake up. It startles me a bit when it happens, but like I said, I wouldn't actually do anything to harm myself.
